description: This file defines data structures and functions related to argument specifications for Torch JIT, including ArgumentInfo, ArgumentSpec, CompleteArgumentSpec, and associated utilities for handling tensor argument metadata in JIT compilation.

classes.name: ArgumentInfo
classes.description: Holds metadata about a tensor argument, including device, type, dimensions, and whether it requires gradient.

classes.name: ArgumentSpec
classes.description: Represents a set of argument types and presence flags for function inputs.

classes.name: CompleteArgumentSpec
classes.description: Represents a fully specified argument configuration, including tensor sizes and strides, for JIT compilation.

classes.name: CompleteArgumentInfo
classes.description: Provides a read-only view of tensor argument metadata within a CompleteArgumentSpec.

methods.name: defined
methods.description: Checks if the ArgumentInfo is defined.

methods.name: device
methods.description: Returns the device of the tensor argument.

methods.name: requires_grad
methods.description: Indicates if the tensor argument requires gradient computation.

methods.name: dim
methods.description: Returns the number of dimensions of the tensor argument.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the scalar type of the tensor argument.

methods.name: toType
methods.description: Converts ArgumentInfo to a TensorType pointer.

methods.name: numTensors
methods.description: Returns the number of tensor arguments.

methods.name: tensorAt
methods.description: Accesses tensor argument info at a specific index.

methods.name: numOptionals
methods.description: Returns the number of optional arguments.

methods.name: isPresent
methods.description: Checks if an optional argument is present.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the precomputed hash code of the ArgumentSpec.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an ArgumentSpec from a stack of input IValues.

methods.name: specializeTypes
methods.description: Specializes argument types based on a graph and ArgumentSpec.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Accesses CompleteArgumentInfo at a specific index.
